record.original_question: If C_1 and C_2 are two convex curves in parallel planes, must every compact embedded constant-mean-curvature surface spanning C_1 union C_2 be a topological annulus?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.6 (4*). Let C1 and C2 be two convex curves in parallel planes. Is a compact embedded cmc surface spanning C1 union C2 a topological annulus?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $C_1$ and $C_2$ be two smooth simple closed convex curves lying in distinct parallel planes in $\mathbb{R}^3$. Let $\Sigma \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ be a compact embedded surface (with boundary) of constant mean curvature whose boundary $\partial \Sigma$ equals $C_1 \cup C_2$. Must $\Sigma$ be homeomorphic to a topological annulus (cylinder)?
artifact.status_search_result: Partial results exist for the minimal (H=0) case (e.g., results by Meeks, Schoen, and others showing the surface is an annulus when the planes are close, or under curvature/distance hypotheses), and embedded CMC surfaces spanning such configurations are known to be radial graphs under certain assumptions. However, the general question for arbitrary constant mean curvature spanning surfaces with two convex parallel boundary curves appears to remain open, with no full classification located.

status_evidence.title: On minimal surfaces bounded by two convex curves in parallel planes
status_evidence.snippet: A compact minimal surface bounded by two closed convex curves in parallel planes close enough to each other must be topologically an annulus.
status_evidence.claim: Result is known in the minimal case under a closeness hypothesis, but not in full generality for CMC.

status_evidence.title: Radial Graphs of Constant Mean Curvature and Doubly Connected Minimal Surfaces with Prescribed Boundary
status_evidence.snippet: A CMC surface spanning two convex curves in parallel planes exists under hypotheses on plane distance, curvature of curves and mean curvature, with the surface a radial graph.
status_evidence.claim: Existence/regularity results exist under hypotheses, but the topological annulus question for general embedded CMC spanning surfaces remains unresolved.
